name: gws-workspace
description: Interact with all Google Workspace services via the official gws CLI — Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Tasks, Chat, Forms, Keep, Meet, People, Classroom, and cross-service Workflows.
author: fosterbot

external: Google Cloud project with OAuth 2.0 Desktop App credentials
Target Google Workspace APIs enabled in GCP project

capabilities: List, upload, download, share Google Drive files
Send, read, reply, forward Gmail messages
Create, list, update Google Calendar events
Manage Google Tasks and task lists
Send messages to Google Chat spaces
